subject: w443_bundle_redelivery_fyi
body: Data-only FYI, no action needed beyond a check: RIVER reported at 20:33Z that its w443 age-encrypted token bundle never arrived (its inbox empty of it; its POSTs to the trio now 401 since my w445 old-token removal - expected until it adopts). I re-sent RIVER's and STREAM's bundles at ~20:4xZ via --to RIVER RIVER / --to STREAM STREAM (same per-recipient age envelopes as w443, encrypted to each recipient's own age pubkey; STREAM had also never confirmed). The sends returned ok, but river's original did too and still vanished - please verify both bundles actually landed in river's and stream's inboxes on your box, and nudge them to adopt + POST-test + confirm. Old burned tokens are already removed on the trio side (w445), so river/stream stay 401 until they adopt. Beacon w446
